guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以「密閉堆肥的混料、供氧、散熱與成熟度證據」為主軸，依序處理可堆肥物與雜質驗收、含水率混合設計、需氧與送風分配、蒸發損失與補水、熟化速率與穩定度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on Blend, oxygenate, cool and verify maturation in enclosed composting, progressing through Compostable feed and contamination, Moisture blending, Oxygen demand and air distribution, Evaporation and water replacement, Curing rate and stability. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
procedure: 只將 f 改成 0.22，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 180 變成 220 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 B 的 N 改成 1 kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 32 變成 26.6667 kg C/kg N。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將調理料 wb 改成 0.30，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 428.571 變成 599 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Vw 改成 3.5 m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.45 變成 0.35 m³ air/m³ bulk。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 η 改成 0.25，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 147.783 變成 206.897 kg air/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 ΔT 改成 50 K，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變成 150 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 m 改成 130 kg/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 62.6944 變成 81.5028 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Q 改成 40 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變成 15 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 k 改成 0.07 d⁻¹，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 36.7879 變成 49.6585 mg/L。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
procedureEn: Change only f to 0.22, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 180 to 220 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only B nitrogen to 1 kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 32 to 26.6667 kg C/kg N. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only bulking-agent wb to 0.30, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 428.571 to 599 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only water volume Vw to 3.5 m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.45 to 0.35 m³ air/m³ bulk. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only η to 0.25, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 147.783 to 206.897 kg air/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only ΔT to 50 K, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 120 to 150 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only m to 130 kg/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 62.6944 to 81.5028 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Q to 40 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 20 to 15 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only k to 0.07 d⁻¹, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 36.7879 to 49.6585 mg/L. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
evidence: 針對「可堆肥物與雜質驗收」，秤總樣與分離後成分，保存含水率與分樣方式，檢查回收率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「碳氮總量配料」，用原料乾質量與元素分析求 C、N 質量，再檢查混合樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「含水率混合設計」，對原料與混合樣作同一乾燥法量測，核對預測值與不同位置樣本。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「填料孔隙與壓實」，測堆積密度、含水量和壓降，分辨孔隙不足與氣流短路。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「需氧與送風分配」，在進出口量氧濃度與流量，觀察不同位置氧剖面而非只讀總管。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「生物熱與顯熱移除」，在同一時段讀取流量與上下游溫度，加入散熱項後檢查能量殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「蒸發損失與補水」，做乾物質與水分收支，核對排氣含濕量及冷凝水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「批次停留與短流」，先扣除無效空間，再用示蹤或批次記錄核對停留時間是否分散。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「熟化速率與穩定度」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「密閉系統與故障交接」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
evidenceEn: For Compostable feed and contamination, Weigh the bulk sample and separated fraction; retain moisture basis and sampling procedure and check recovery. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting, Use dry feed mass and elemental analysis to calculate C and N masses, then check the blend. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Moisture blending, Measure both feeds and blend by the same drying method; compare prediction with spatial subsamples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Bed porosity and compaction, Measure bulk density, moisture and pressure drop to distinguish insufficient porosity from gas bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Oxygen demand and air distribution, Measure inlet and outlet oxygen and flow; inspect spatial oxygen profiles rather than only the main header. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Biological heat and sensible cooling, Record flow and upstream/downstream temperatures over one interval; include losses and check the energy residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Evaporation and water replacement, Close dry-solids and water balances, checking exhaust humidity and condensate. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Batch residence and short-circuiting, Subtract inactive volume, then compare tracer or batch records to detect a broad residence-time distribution. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Curing rate and stability, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Enclosure failure and handoff, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
pitfalls: 濕基與乾基混用會令回收物或負荷被高估。 在「可堆肥物與雜質驗收」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
相同總 C:N 仍可能因木質素或抑制物而有不同分解速度。 在「碳氮總量配料」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
調理料本身很濕，卻仍用乾料假設計算，會低估需要量。 在「含水率混合設計」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
過度壓實或積水會關閉氣道，讓平均送風量失去代表性。 在「填料孔隙與壓實」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
旁通氣流增加時總送風上升，但反應區仍可能缺氧。 在「需氧與送風分配」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
忽略水分蒸發會把熱量全部誤算為升溫。 在「生物熱與顯熱移除」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
把材料減重全當作有機物破壞，會混淆乾燥與反應。 在「蒸發損失與補水」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
把幾何容積當有效容積，會掩蓋短流與未處理區。 在「批次停留與短流」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「熟化速率與穩定度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「密閉系統與故障交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
pitfallsEn: Mixing wet and dry bases overstates recovered material or loading. Mark where this error can enter the Compostable feed and contamination flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

The same total C:N can yield different degradation rates because of lignin or inhibitors. Mark where this error can enter the Carbon-nitrogen blend accounting flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Treating a wet bulking agent as dry underestimates required addition. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture blending flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Compaction or waterlogging closes gas paths, making mean airflow unrepresentative. Mark where this error can enter the Bed porosity and compaction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Increasing bypass airflow can raise total supply while reactive zones remain oxygen-limited. Mark where this error can enter the Oxygen demand and air distribution flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Ignoring evaporation incorrectly assigns all heat to temperature rise. Mark where this error can enter the Biological heat and sensible cooling flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Treating all weight loss as organic destruction confuses drying with reaction. Mark where this error can enter the Evaporation and water replacement flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Using geometric volume as effective volume hides short-circuiting and untreated zones. Mark where this error can enter the Batch residence and short-circuiting flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Curing rate and stability flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Enclosure failure and handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

courses.summary: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。
courses.summaryEn: The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.
